Formatieplaats.title: Formation place
Formatieplaats.description: A budgeted place in a unit's formation: a number of FTE for one function, filled by the contracts that name it or vacant. Occupancy is computed on read, never stored (people-formation-positions).

orgUnitId.title: Unit
orgUnitId.description: The unit this place belongs to.
orgUnitId.x-notes: people-formation-positions D1. Required: a place outside a unit has no budget holder.

normfunctieId.title: Reference job
normfunctieId.description: The reference job this place is budgeted for. Leave empty when the place is not tied to one.
normfunctieId.x-notes: people-formation-positions D1: a tender asks for the formation per function.

title.title: Name
title.description: What the place is called, for example Medewerker burgerzaken.

budgetedFte.title: Budgeted FTE
budgetedFte.description: How many FTE the budget allows on this place. One FTE is a full-time working week of 40 hours.
budgetedFte.x-notes: Same 40-hour full-time week as AbsenceRateService::DEFAULT_FULL_TIME_HOURS_PER_WEEK, so filled and budgeted FTE are counted in one unit.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The first day the place is in the formation.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The last day the place is in the formation. Leave empty while it lasts.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the place is still part of the formation. A discontinued place no longer counts in the unit.
status.x-notes: people-formation-positions D1: a plain enum, no lifecycle; two states and no guarded transition.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration this place belongs to.
